modules.module_title: Plan the interior garden and features

pcs.pc_description: conduct a site survey to assess various parameters including the client requirements
ensure that the site has a conducive environment for supporting an interior garden such as adequate sunlight exposure, good air- circulation, availability of water and electricity, etc.
measure the available space for the purpose of preparing a layout
select an appropriate garden theme
identify the relevant plants and shrubs for the interior garden such as bonsai, dracaena, areca palm, etc.
select various garden features and structures to be installed in coordination with the client
plan the placement of various plants and garden features
select various material required for setting up the interior garden such as pots, containers, hanging baskets, planters, fixtures, artificial lighting, etc
prepare a layout based on the available space and client preferences
ensure the layout allows for plant rotation, shifting and free movement in the garden
prepare the cost estimates for setting up an interior garden

modules.module_title: Arrange and store the necessary material

pcs.pc_description: identify a vendor to purchase the material required for setting up the interior garden such as seeds, planting material, fertilizers, pesticides/ insecticides, pots, etc.
purchase the material in the required number/ quantity
store the material as per the relevant storage, health and safety requirements
organise the relevant tools, equipment and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
maintain the record of purchase

modules.module_title: Propagate plants for the interior garden

pcs.pc_description: select an appropriate method such as seeding, cutting, layering to propagate indoor plants
prepare the soil for propagation by applying the necessary treatment
prepare pots of appropriate size or a nursery bed for propagating plants
plant seeds/ stems/ root in the pots/ nursery bed for propagation
apply water and fertilizers in the recommended quantity
apply pesticides/ insecticides to protect the plantlets from pests/ insects and diseases
maintain the plantlets until they are ready for transplanting

modules.module_title: Prepare the potting soil and pots

pcs.pc_description: arrange coir peat, vermiculite and compost in the recommended quantity for preparing potting soil
select a clean container of appropriate capacity to prepare the potting soil
prepare the coir peat for use by soaking it in water for the recommended duration
create a mixture of coir peat, vermiculite and compost by adding the ingredients in the recommended ratio
add worm castings/ vermicompost to the mixture as per the requirement
rake the potting soil to break any lumps and aerate it
use pots/ containers of appropriate capacity and shape having aesthetic appeal
create drainage holes in the bottom of the pots/ containers
prepare pots for planting by filling them with potting soil
create holes of appropriate depth and width in the potting soil

modules.module_title: Set up the interior garden and features

pcs.pc_description: plant the selected plants/ trees/ shrubs in the interior garden and pots/ containers
plant grass in the interior garden’s lawn
apply water and fertilizers in the recommended quantity
place plants/ trees/ shrubs in groups according to their varieties and light and water requirements
set up shelves or other relevant support for placing the indoor plant pots/ containers
arrange fluorescent lights and heat mats to maintain appropriate light and soil temperature for indoor plants
install timers to automate the functioning of fluorescent lights and heat mats
install various garden features such as fountains, hanging baskets, bonsai pots at the client-preferred spots
apply modern architectural designs for interior gardens such as built-in planters and vertical garden panels
set up appropriate irrigation and drainage systems in the interior garden
guide the client on the minor repair and maintenance of the interior garden
arrange for protection from any health and safety hazards in and around the interior garden
use the relevant PPE during the operations
select sustainable or eco-friendly plants and materials, such as using native plants, biodegradable containers, or sustainable growing methods
implement water-efficient irrigation systems or plant choices to minimize water usage, especially in large installations
optimise the usage of various material in different tasks/ activities/ processes
optimise the usage of water/ electricity/ energy in various tasks/ activities/ processes

modules.module_title: Maintain the plants, trees and shrubs

pcs.pc_description: water the interior garden plants/ trees/ shrubs with the recommended quantity of water
maintain the prescribed level of moisture and soil temperature
apply the recommended quantity of fertilizers and manure to the plants/ trees/ shrubs
carry out pruning and training of the plants/ trees/ shrubs as per the requirement
examine the plants/ trees/ shrubs regularly for pest infestation
apply the approved pesticides/ insecticides as per the manufacturer’s instructions
rake the lawn to remove dead leaves and debris
remove the weeds and wilted plants/ tree/ shrubs as per the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
drain out excess water from the garden appropriately
carry out plant rotation and shifting for the healthy growth of plants/ trees/ shrubs
maintain the record of fertilizers, pesticides and insecticides used in the garden

modules.module_title: Maintain the garden features and structures

pcs.pc_description: maintain the cleanliness of interior garden features and structures
carry out minor repair, maintenance and replacement of the garden features and structures
co-ordinate with an expert for any complex repair and maintenance activities
polish the metal containers with the recommended material

modules.module_title: Maintain the garden tools and equipment

pcs.pc_description: examine various garden hand/ power tools and equipment for any wear and tear or damage
carry out minor repair and maintenance of the tools and equipment
store the tools and equipment as per the manufacturer’s instructions
segregate waste into different categories
dispose of dead plants, clippings, and other organic waste in an environmentally friendly manner, such as composting
dispose the non-recyclable waste appropriately
deposit the recyclable and reusable material at the identified location
repurpose or recycle containers, soil, or plant materials wherever possible
